handles.audit_path: github.com/2b-rs/autodocs/settings/keys — last used date shown per key entry

handles.purpose: Sign digest-bound readiness records and approval commits through a task-scoped SSH agent
handles.scope: SSH signatures only; namespaces git and autodocs-readiness; no network authentication
handles.reconfirmation: Current-user confirmation is required before each architecture approval and after any policy or key change
handles.revocation_path: Remove the agent-commit-key signer and authority entries, remove this handle, and disable the host credential
handles.audit_path: Retained signed record, verification output, handle identifier, public fingerprint, and task-scoped runner result
